title: MySQL named locks for multi-server ID generation
summary: Centralized GET_LOCK usage in Core\MySqlNamedLock. PAPSID, STRID, and grievance case number allocation now hold locks through INSERT. Documented multi-app-server requirements (shared MySQL primary).

items: run() wraps GET_LOCK with timeout validation and guaranteed RELEASE_LOCK
Profile::create, Structure::create, Grievance::create hold lock through insert
Grievance::computeNextCaseNumber + auto case on empty grievance_case_number
Refactored generatePAPSID, generateSTRID, generateCaseNumber to use helper
